Container.Name: TwentyFourSeven
Container.Overview: TwentyFourSeven turns your movie and TV folders (or your Plex library) into always-on TV channels with a program guide for any IPTV app. The Media path shares your Unraid shares with TwentyFourSeven read-only; after install, press Find my videos in Settings to pick your movie and TV folders. TwentyFourSeven only reads them. Install WatchTower first: sign-in goes through WatchTower. A graphics card is optional.
Container.Requires: WatchTower (install and set it up first). Optional NVIDIA video: install the NVIDIA-Driver plugin and add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Main HTTP port for the application. This is the only port you need to access TwentyFourSeven.

Config.Name: External HTTP Port
Config.Description: Automatically set to match the HTTP Port above. Used for internal URL configuration.

Config.Name: Server URL
Config.Description: Public server URL for API calls. REQUIRED for proper functionality! Set to http://YOUR_UNRAID_IP:[PORT:80] (replace YOUR_UNRAID_IP with your actual Unraid server IP address)

Config.Name: Trusted Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for authentication. REQUIRED for external access! Example: http://localhost:[PORT:80],http://192.168.1.100:[PORT:80] (replace 192.168.1.100 with your Unraid server IP)

Config.Name: Authentication Secret
Config.Description: Leave empty: TFS makes one on first start and keeps it in Database Storage, so updates do not sign anyone out. If you set or change it, everyone is signed out once.

Config.Name: Enable GPU Detection
Config.Description: Enable automatic GPU detection and hardware acceleration support.

Config.Name: Enable Hardware Acceleration
Config.Description: Enable hardware-accelerated video transcoding when supported GPU is detected.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA only (also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters). all = every NVIDIA card. Ignored without an NVIDIA card.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA driver capabilities for hardware acceleration. - DO NOT CHANGE unless you know what you're doing.

Config.Name: Database Storage
Config.Description: Keeps your channels, settings and the sign-in key. Do not leave empty, or everything is lost on update. If you see database permission errors, run: chown -R 1001:100 /mnt/user/appdata/twentyfourseven/database in the Unraid terminal.

Config.Name: Static Files Storage
Config.Description: Path to store static files (.m3u, .xml, etc.). Files placed here will be accessible at http://[IP]:[PORT]/files/. If you see permission errors, run: chown -R 1001:100 /mnt/user/appdata/twentyfourseven/static in the Unraid terminal.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Lets TwentyFourSeven look at your shares, read-only, so you can pick your movie and TV folders in Settings (Find my videos or Browse). It can never change or delete anything here. Want it to see less? Change this to your media share, for example /mnt/user/Media.

Config.Name: Movies Folder
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty if the Media path above already covers your movies. Otherwise your movies folder, for example /mnt/user/Movies. TwentyFourSeven only reads it.

Config.Name: TV Shows Folder
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty if the Media path above already covers your TV shows. Otherwise your TV folder, for example /mnt/user/TV. One folder per show works best (Show Name/Season 01/Show Name - S01E01.mkv). TwentyFourSeven only reads it.

Config.Name: YouTube Downloads Folder
Config.Description: Optional. Only for Settings > YouTube. A folder TwentyFourSeven may write to, for example /mnt/user/YouTube. Your Movies, TV and Media folders stay read-only. Also set the YouTube Download Folder variable below to /youtube.

Config.Name: YouTube Download Folder
Config.Description: Optional. Set to /youtube when you map the YouTube Downloads Folder above. Leave empty if you do not use YouTube channels.

Config.Name: FFMPEG Auto-Detect
Config.Description: Automatically detect FFMPEG installation path.

Config.Name: Hardware Acceleration Device
Config.Description: Hardware acceleration device path. For NVIDIA use /dev/nvidia0, for Intel/AMD use /dev/dri/renderD128.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Application log level (debug, info, warn, error).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for the container (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, etc.).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions. Use 'id username' command to find your user ID.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions. Use 'id username' command to find your group ID.
